summary: The frozen streaming XPointer claim remains unresolved. The reader path does enable streaming mode when XInclude processing is active, but the supplied evidence does not show whether the old harness’s reader options activate that path in the supplied build.
missing_information: The reader setup and build defaults needed to determine whether the old harness reaches streaming XInclude processing.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions reject a local XPointer inclusion when streaming mode is enabled. The old harness does not enable streaming mode on its explicit XInclude context. Its reader operation is a possible equivalent route: xmlTextReaderRead enables streaming mode and invokes XInclude processing when reader->xinclude is set. The supplied reader setup and build defaults do not establish whether that condition is reachable.

before.requirement: Process a local XPointer inclusion in streaming mode and reject it with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
before.reason: The restriction exists under LIBXML_XPTR_ENABLED. The explicit context is zero initialized and the harness only sets parse flags. The reader can enable streaming mode, but whether the supplied options set reader->xinclude and whether the required features are built remain unresolved.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The explicit XInclude context starts with streaming mode unset.
The reader enables streaming mode and processes XInclude nodes when reader->xinclude is set.

after.requirement: Process a local XPointer inclusion in streaming mode and reject it with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
after.reason: The same restriction remains. The reader still offers a conditional streaming route, but the supplied evidence does not resolve its option setup or the relevant build defaults.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The explicit XInclude context starts with streaming mode unset.
The reader enables streaming mode and processes XInclude nodes when reader->xinclude is set.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness forces XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE into the options passed to its operations.
The harness also creates and reads an XML reader with those options.

claims.comparison_reason: The same restriction and the same old harness apply on both sides. The reader implementation resolves the earlier uncertainty about whether a streaming route exists, but its activation through reader setup and build defaults is still unproven.
missing_information: Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlTextReaderSetup, to determine how XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE affects reader->xinclude.
Both versions of xmlreader.c::xmlNewTextReader, to establish the reader’s initial state.
